function: Learned computation of the constituent delay-Doppler parameter matrix columns inside a fractional delay-Doppler channel estimator for OTFS (p. 1, p. 3).
system: Single-link OTFS (scalar channel, antennas not stated), M=64, N=32, 30 kHz spacing, 5.1 GHz carrier, five or six paths, no RIS (p. 4).
method: Two fully connected DNNs (real and imaginary parts, 10 layers each), supervised with L1 loss and Adam, trained offline once, then frozen (p. 3, p. 4).
data_channel: 325000 synthetic delay-Doppler tuples with exact matrix columns for training; testing on a Rician five-path channel and ITU Vehicular A (p. 3, p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained once offline on model-generated tuples; tested over pilot SNR 0-20 dB and data SNR 10-35 dB on two power delay profiles (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned only: M-MLE [8], DDIPIC [9], perfect CSI, and brute-force, TF-domain, and [10] methods for runtime; no earlier learned method (p. 4, p. 5).
metrics: NMSE of the delay-Doppler channel estimate, BER with MMSE detection, and average runtime of computing the matrix columns (p. 4, p. 5).
complexity: Runtime of computing matrix columns: 60 s brute force, 1 s TF-domain, 10 s method [10], 0.1 s proposed (Table III, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "the Vehicular A (VehA) channel model with P = 6 paths defined in [14] is considered"; p. 5: "Rec. ITU-R M.1225, 1997" is reference [14], a standardized ITU model; the other profile is a custom Rician model.
q2_support: p. 4: "this training has to be carried out offline, only once"; no test in a scenario, band, or configuration absent from training is stated, only SNR sweeps over two power delay profiles.
q3_support: p. 4: "between the proposed approach, the DDIPIC algorithm in [9], and the M-MLE algorithm in [8]"; both are non-learned, no earlier learned estimator is compared, and DD-domain training in Fig. 3 is a variant of the proposed network.
q4_support: p. 5: "The run time of the proposed method is the best amongst all (better by a factor of at least 10)"; Table III lists 0.1 s for the proposed TF learning.
q5_support: p. 3: "Training data is obtained by generating" (τ, ν) tuples from the system model; no code or data link is given anywhere in the letter, and no public dataset or measurement is used.
notes: Included as OTFS channel estimation (area 4). The DNN learns only the matrix columns r(tau,nu) inside the classical DDIPIC estimator [9], whose coarse search, fine search and refinement stay non-learned. q1 flagged for the reviewer: Vehicular A is ITU-R M.1225 (ref. [14], p. 5), a standardized model other than 3GPP, while the other profile is a custom Rician model and the training data are model-generated tuples, not channel realizations. Fig. 4 legend cites [7] and [8] while its caption cites [9] and [8].
